senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.Susitha (Hippos);district of Hippos (Hippene, Jos. Bell.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 18:4">Tosef. Ohol. XVIII, 4</cite> (gentile towns in Palestine) <he>כגון ס׳ וחבירותיה</he> (Var. <cite ref="O00758"><he>סִיסִית</he></cite>) like S. and her sister towns.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 4:10">Tosef. Shebi. IV, 10</cite> <he>תחום סוסיתה</he> Var. ed. Zuck. (ed. <cite ref="R00440"><he>ציצית</he></cite>, <cite ref="R00442"><he>ציציתה</he></cite>) the district of S.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1:18">Y. Dem. II, 22ᵈ</cite> top <he>ס׳</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 6:1:13">Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ארץ טוב זו ס׳</he> ‘the land of Tob’ (<cite ref="Judges 11:3">Jud. XI, 3</cite>) that is the district of S. Ib. VIII, 38ᵃ <he>מן ס׳ לטבריא</he> from S. to Tiberias.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite>; s. 32 <he>כמן טבריא לסוסתא</he> (ed. Leipz. <he>לסיסטא</he>; corr. acc.) as the distance (on the Lake of Tiberias) from T. to S.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23:5">Lev. R. s. 23</cite> <he>כגון … ס׳ לט׳</he> as hostile as S. to T.; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:2:5">Cant. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>סוסיתן</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:52">Lam. R. to I, 17</cite>; a. e.
